note: Ambience recordings under the synthesised System World soundscape. Every source is CC0 1.0 (public-domain dedication) as stated on its own page; the user approved these downloads on 2026-11-10. The sources are not kept in the repository: download them into <dir>/<id>/<source_file> and run build_audio.py --sources <dir>.

recordings.role: Water moving against a floating pontoon; plays by the quay.
recordings.title: Pontoon, marina
recordings.author: Joseph SARDIN
recordings.cut_note: The calmest stretch of the recording; later ones slap hard enough to read as hooves. The high-pass removes a low hum near 100 Hz.

recordings.role: Wind in tree tops; plays in the green, louder with the wind.
recordings.title: Wind in the Trees
recordings.author: Joseph SARDIN
recordings.cut_note: The calm middle of the recording. The gusty first minute reads as rain as much as leaves, the stretches after 106 s carry birdsong, and a low-pass makes any cut read as rain on a roof, so the cut stays unfiltered.

recordings.role: Blackbirds, blackcaps and a wren in a town garden; plays in the green by day.
recordings.title: Birds in the City #1
recordings.author: Joseph SARDIN

recordings.role: Gulls crying over a small fishing port; plays at the harbour.
recordings.title: Gulls on the Harbor
recordings.author: Joseph SARDIN
recordings.cut_note: The stretches before 72 s and after 95 s may carry voices in the background; the cut stays between them.

recordings.role: Distant traffic hum of a quiet city at night; plays between the towers and on the squares.
recordings.title: XY_City hum_Night_River_ambience.wav
recordings.author: softwalls
recordings.source_note: The site's MP3 preview; the original WAV needs an account.

recordings.role: Light rain falling on a street; plays outdoors in rain.
recordings.title: Rain_light_3.mp3
recordings.author: SoundAppProject
recordings.source_note: The site's MP3 preview; the original MP3 needs an account.
